scope: Convoy current-operation command admission and actual applied smoothing records
finding: Per-command helper checked current crew/external availability but not original brain/job/registry/configuration/epoch. Lead and two follower smoothing journals could record rejected caps.
implementation: Capture original tick brain/token/registry revision/epoch and registry row index. Each existing command helper refuses changed/cancelled/finished brain, token, epoch, configuration or indexed registry row; row lookup is constant-time after one entry search. Lead and PACE/TRAIL follower cap journals move beside forceSpeed in their admitted transactions.
limits: No spacing formula, tolerance, braking envelope or acceleration rate changed.
Not complete convoy writer atomicity: early setup/progress/path bookkeeping and lifecycle publication still need review.
Additional bounded context checks at command proposals; runtime cost unmeasured.
Physical mixed tracked/wheeled step-off, braking, gaps, replacements, HC and performance remain unaccepted.

semanticPublication.finding: OperationStep checked identity only before scheduled ConvoyTick; later phase/counters/follow-up timing could publish after replacement.
semanticPublication.implementation: Post-tick and final isNil checks retain original epoch/brain/job/configuration/revision/indexed registry row, uncancelled/unfinished state and no Zeus/external owner. Final local-state identity must match; phase/counters/timing/public snapshot publish together. Refusal cancels only this callback brain.
semanticPublication.limits: No new worker or geometry query; actual interruption, same-value provenance, cached state freshness and measured cost remain unverified.

terminalRetirement.finding: Finished checked brain before calling potentially yielding release, then cleared brain/FSM slots unconditionally inside that older outer branch.
terminalRetirement.implementation: Post-release isNil requires same brain, original job token and registry revision before clearing both slots.
terminalRetirement.limits: Only final slots; prior public terminal snapshot and ReleaseLocal internal state/policy/path cleanup remain separate review work. Physical replacement race and overhead unverified.
